executive_summary: The Denver City Council meeting on May 8th, 2017, was called to order by Council Secretary Kelly Vales. Due to the absence of the required quorum, all business was moved to the next meeting on May 15th. The meeting concluded with birthday wishes for Council members.

positions: Room air conditioners are less expensive but cool smaller areas.
Central air conditioners cool the entire house but are more expensive.
Evaporative coolers cost less to install and use less energy but require more maintenance and are suitable for low humidity areas.
Fans can create a wind chill effect, making the home feel cooler.

unresolved_items: All business was moved to the next meeting on May 15th.
